Thiven Anderson is a student at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu) studying General Engineering with a particular interest in mechanical engineering, controls, and embedded systems. His coursework has given him experience across a broad range of engineering disciplines, including mechanical design, electronics, digital systems, control theory, and materials science.

He has worked on interdisciplinary engineering projects ranging from FPGA-based digital systems and autonomous robots to precision mechanical components. He has also conducted materials research investigating non-toxic brass alloys and worked on industry-sponsored engineering projects that emphasize solving open-ended problems and meeting real-world stakeholder needs.

Thiven is also involved in teaching and mentorship, having worked as a teaching assistant and tutor in subjects spanning engineering, mathematics, and the sciences. He enjoys breaking down technical concepts and helping other students develop an intuitive understanding of challenging material.
